findings.title: An inverted EXPANDED reply is committed before its axis-order postcondition is checked
findings.source_evidence: check_city_expand_reply checks state/name/count, finite words and zero trailing words, but never checks min[i] <= max[i]. The exchange then writes six output words; ct_msgs assigns all six mirror components and only afterwards evaluates its three ASSERTs. A well-named six-finite-word payload with one inverted axis passes the new dialogue validation.
findings.shipping_assert_qualification: The actual supported cc::Build defines neither DEBUG nor DEBUG_ASSERT; ASSERT is write_debug_log in modules/system/assert.h:74..86, not an atomic fatal validation guard. The earlier reviewer shorthand that these ASSERTs reject an inverted reply was too strong and is corrected here. It is insufficient even in a fatal-assert build because the writes precede it.
findings.original_behavior_boundary: The initial phase14 sentinel with minimum1e6 and maximum-1e6 remains valid. After one valid finite original expansion, BOTH p1 and p2 are unioned into BOTH min and max on each axis; even if heading swaps the two corners, the resulting expanded axes are ordered. No eight-corner repair, corner re-sort or rejection of valid original two-corner behavior is requested.
findings.required_correction: After the existing raw finite classification, validate numeric min<=max for all three EXPANDED axes before any caller-buffer or Core mirror write. Use raw-word ordering or another check that adds no FP exception/rounding side effect; treat signed zeros as numerically equal without changing their bits. Refuse malformed EXPANDED output by a named box reason. Do not impose this expansion postcondition on the legal initial phase14 sentinel.
findings.focused_validation: Use the existing real C dialogue/canary collaborator: valid expanded reply positive first, then each single inverted axis must refuse with the whole output untouched. Retain signed-zero equality, finite-word and count/name/tail checks. No bad native experiment or new physical solver is needed.
findings.effect: A boundary/schema and atomic mirror-commit defect; no valid retail default failure has been measured.

findings.title: Boot witness can withdraw before a full current parent join and has incomplete grammar/failure classification

subitems.source_evidence: request_join_problem(city_expand) requires non-ended keys, acknowledged CITY and fixed states, and only a non-nil scan.city.parent[child]. It does not join that tracked parent/list anchor to parsed.city. scan_question then sets box_eligible and sends the real state withdrawal before delegating the question. A live CITY A and a live held child of CITY B can mutate B state before the real provider rejects the mismatched pair. The final marker/cause checks prevent false acceptance, but do not prevent that invalid mutation.
subitems.required_correction: Resolve the CURRENT sector CITY placement through actual acknowledged LINK/list-anchor equivalence and require the child belongs to that same current record/list before eligibility or withdrawal. Do not directly compare unrelated transient sector and retained list-anchor keys. Track enough lifecycle/acknowledged alias history to admit legitimate empty/repopulate/relink behavior; do not fabricate a parent association from callback order.
subitems.focused_validation: Positive current pair and legitimate retained-anchor/relinked CITY pair; then two live cities with their own acknowledged states and a live child of the other city. Wrong-parent case must have request failure, zero eligibility/withdrawal and no state mutation. The original unmodified request may still reach its real provider refusal once; it cannot authorize withdrawal.

subitems.source_evidence: expand_reply_problem checks length65 and gmatch nonempty comma tokens, not exactly six tokens or exact separator structure. Five valid10-character words plus15 commas have length65 and each visited token passes, so the wrapper can credit a malformed answer. tonumber also is not the existing exact PATTERN grammar.
subitems.required_correction: Reuse words_of_text(answer.p,6), which checks each exact pattern, exact token count and reconstruction, then perform raw finite checks before expand_answered credit. Preserve all current valid words, including signed zero/subnormal transport.
subitems.focused_validation: A positive six-word answer, then five valid words with extra/consecutive/trailing commas totalling65 bytes must fail without answered credit. Include a signed/whitespace pseudo-hex form if it exercises the tonumber gap; no new parser framework.

subitems.source_evidence: box_verdict checks a zero-withdrawal boot fatal only when failure.marker differs from the planned entity_scan.refused marker. A boot fatal at that same generic marker with no credited withdrawal and zero locally recorded faults falls through to UNREACHED. That is not a clean missing expansion prerequisite.
subitems.required_correction: With no acknowledged control withdrawal, ANY recognized fatal at boot is a failure, including the same generic expected marker with an unrelated cause. Keep UNREACHED only for a clean no-fatal boot that lacks an eligible expansion. Continue to avoid every poisoned engine physical/counter/metrics/close call.
subitems.focused_validation: An unrelated pre-expansion boot refusal at entity_scan.refused must remain failure/no withdrawal rather than UNREACHED or PASS; genuine clean no-expansion stays UNREACHED, and genuine withdrawn-building refusal still passes. Preserve exactly-once delegation and safe file-close handling.

findings.effect: Finite test witness admission/report truth; the real provider relationship check is already correct. No production math change is requested for this group.

decision.instruction: Batch the two bounded groups in the same sole implementation lane before exact corrected-source review/build/native clearance. Do not run known-bad diagnostic/expanded-reply cases natively.

verified_source_positives: Hosted ct_msgs excludes the physical Core expansion; the explicit original branch retains the original function body. The Host uses the existing final ModelStore and the same canonical CITY and child records, not a second geometry/property store.

Actual en_list ordering is child insertion/report, LINK_CHILD expansion, then LINK_PARENT. The CITY sector placement and building child placement/fixed state exist before the new request. C map preflight checks current child ownership under that CITY slot; request uses semantic roster-key pair and no raw pointer/entity index.

The real provider joins a live CITY sector entry to a child of the same record before looking up geometry. Missing/withdrawn CITY or building state and mismatched pair refuse before computation/mutation. The model store is fetched only for phase15; old scan phases retain their no-model behavior.

The host kernel retains the original two corners, matrix routine, alias-safe vector multiply, float narrowing, relative offsets, strict comparisons and no-shrink union, including valid sentinel and signed-zero behavior. No source-supported numeric solver defect was established in this pass.

Input exponent words are classified as integers before f32 construction/arithmetic. Scene domain and inventory-only stores are refused. Kernel failure withholds the result; the host record is replaced whole only after a successful finite result. No numerical/physical Core fallback is present.

The Expanded decision transports six words through Sys/Engine/DC without widening legacy object-ID domains. Key pair maximum41 fits the existing128-byte per-operation identity limit; lazy object identity timing is unchanged. Count/name/tail/finite guards are present; only the missing expanded-axis postcondition remains in finding1.

Boot refusal handling uses pcall around boot and retained wrapper state; no Engine object is constructed on its fatal branch, the verdict does not ask for box/counters/metrics or close a poisoned engine, and the outer close is the owned evidence file. This correct safety property is not a substitute for finding2 admission/report fixes.

eech_engine_boot at343 enters OPERATION_BOOT; boot at195 also selects the original zero rounding. modules/system/fpu.c:317 changes the rounding field, not exception masks; set_fpu_exceptions is a no-op in the current source.

FPU_BOOT_disposition.known_side_effect_difference: The old inline arithmetic could add sticky flags inside the engine entry; the Host kernel restores its caller pre-state. The actual scoped argument is masked numerical arithmetic, no active Core sticky-status reader found in the relevant source, and public engine-entry restoration on normal/fatal exit. Do not promote this to identical FP state at every intermediate callback.
FPU_BOOT_disposition.numeric_and_environment_tests: The recorded1440 comparisons are4scenes x9headings x5offsets x4boxes x2caller rounding modes.
